resolvedQuestions.text: What is the source-defined data.json schema?
Which commands map to the requested operations?
How do installation and enablement work at the file layer?
What is the safe AI workflow?
Which automation errors and edge cases matter?

keyFindings.text: The source defines Settings fields/defaults and uses a shallow default merge.
A non-frozen install has a pluginSubListFrozenVersion entry whose version is latest.
The current palette has one add command with or without version, rather than necessarily two historical command titles.
A pin is the exact GitHub release tag, not merely a semver-normalized manifest version.
main.js and manifest.json are required release assets; styles.css is optional.
File-layer enablement must use manifest.id and preserve the community-plugin enable list.
Themes use root CSS/manifest files and a manifest-name target folder, not GitHub release assets.
Private access requires an already-authorized SecretStorage value; data.json is not sufficient.
An absent incoming styles.css does not cause BRAT to delete an existing one.
GitHub caching can temporarily make a freshly published update unavailable.

ruledOutDirections.approach: Store a personal access token in data.json
Fetch normal BRAT plugin artifacts from repository root
Automatically force an incompatible minAppVersion install
Delete installed theme files when unregistering a beta theme
Place a private GitHub token directly in data.json
